EPISODE_NARRATIVE: Elevated river levels along portions of the Little Sioux and Ocheyedan River Basins continued from May into early June due to ongoing wet and rainy conditions.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: The Little Sioux River near Milford continued above flood stage from May, cresting around 3.67 ft above flood stage (15.67 ft) on June 4th. This crest is in the Moderate Stage. The river then fell below flood stage on the afternoon of June 11th.
